'''plasma Just another Hunt Down''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[plasma]]
* '''Published:''' 6 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 HD plasma DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hunt Down non dueler.

== Strategy ==

Ususal start is Fear is my ally, Hunt Down the Executor sites a VIsage, Prepared Defences, LLL V, Blaster Rack V, and No Escape.

Spend the fist couple turn getting locations out of your deck, Find Vader and deploy him and battle.  Remeber the game text of all your cards.  WWin Report your differental.  Have Fun!
